about.title: Reliability and precision in gas supply
about.text1: Caspian Gaz Group supplies technical and specialty gases to industrial plants and laboratories. Purity grade, safety and on-time delivery come first in every order.
about.text2: Our goal is for each customer to receive the right gas, at the right purity, in the right cylinder, at the right time.
about.missionText: To support our customers' production and analysis with uninterrupted, safe and precise gas supply.
about.visionText: To become one of the most trusted partners in industrial and laboratory gases in the region.
